en.title: Compound Cumulative Scoring
en.excerpt: How cumulative point scoring operates for Compound individual and team elimination matches.
en.content:
Cumulative Point Addition

Compound bow competition uses Cumulative Scoring rather than the Set System. Every arrow value is added directly to a running total score across all ends.

Individual Match Format (15 Arrows)

Individual Compound matches consist of 5 ends of 3 arrows (15 arrows total, maximum score of 150 points). The archer with the highest cumulative total score after 15 arrows wins the match.

Team Match Format (24 Arrows)

Team Compound matches consist of 4 ends of 6 arrows (24 arrows total, maximum score of 240 points). The team with the highest combined total score wins.

Compound Match Tie Resolutions

If both competitors finish with identical cumulative totals (e.g., 144-144), a single-arrow shoot-off determines the winner based on score or closest-to-center proximity.
